replay.detail: Native pi and OMP adoption keeps its existing process supervision and terminal fencing.

schema.detail: No stored or wire format changes and no historical data cleanup.

rules.detail: Native ownership and session incarnation checks remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Removes the uncalled workspace-internal OMP catalog adopt API and its private resolver. Current callers retain the explicit-path native adoption APIs, which already omit legacy presence transport. The Clippy baseline is tightened by the one too-many-arguments warning removed with the unused resolver.

downtime.detail: No active provider restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator action or data cleanup is required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the unused source entrypoint without rewriting stored state.
